metadata.displayText:
remove cipher key. make colour scheme lighter (brown text, beige background), change text to be more minimalistic and visible. set phrases to be newly generated each time it's opened i.e. no word bank. 

Process: 
The LLM generates a short phrase or word. 
This is then encrypted and presented to the player, along with the surprisal value of the original and the entropy of the phrase.
The player guesses letters in the unencrypted phrase/word. If the letters are correct, they are displayed beneath the encrypted phrase at the corresponding locations. If not, the hangman increments. The entropy is updated. 
The goal is to guess the original phrase in its entirety before the hangman is completed. 
The player can optionally guess the cypher type and offset. 

Scratch work area for calculations and note-taking
Optional cipher testing area (select cipher + offset and enter text; doesn’t count as a guess)
Cipher can be pre-selected or randomised (as well as its constraints eg. no number-based ciphers, only substitution ciphers)
Difficulty can be pre-selected (eg. easy mode = surprisal ≤ certain value)
Entropy and surprisal display can be toggled
Brief explanation on the history and use cases of the cipher selected, along with fun facts 
eg. the ROT13 cipher is the same as the Caesar cipher with an offset of 13, and encrypting a phrase with ROT13 twice returns the original phrase. 

ciphers available: caesar, rot13, atbash, a1z26, binary, morse
